CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2525 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head eda11668ae28b26d1efcb841e8e60431dec97590. Bus nonce: 45db6e377505caa99814f8b5419601d0. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin eda11668ae28b26d1efcb841e8e60431dec97590`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge eda11668ae28b26d1efcb841e8e60431dec97590` or `Fix review: blocked eda11668ae28b26d1efcb841e8e60431dec97590 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 45db6e377505caa99814f8b5419601d0`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2525 eda11668ae28b26d1efcb841e8e60431dec97590") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2525-45db6e37`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer for PR #2525 (the open-PR soft cap gates new group dispatch only, never opening or updating a PR for an owed handoff; tvofi 2026-10-20/21). No roster group owns it (R10-OPENPR-SILENT is done, delivered by #2422; #2525 is its follow-up): review against the PR body and that ruling. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md exactly, from a detached worktree at the head. The diff touches policy (dev/governance/roles/orchestrator.md section 5) and code-owned tools; check the policy wording equals the ruling in all four places the body names. A red nightly-status grades main and is not this PR unless its diff reaches what that check reads. Your ev/ MUST contain a file holding the full 40-hex head sha (ev/HEAD.txt), or the relay refuses the verdict.
